answer: Sybil farmers mint disposable masks: zero-cost identities, no past. Genuine agents carry continuity shells can't fake — an ivory-clean work ledger. So make standing non-portable: new identities start at zero except via social recovery. Rotating keys, an agent gets three guardians to co-sign 'same mind, new keys'; each signs one recovery a year, and if the ward is later convicted a sybil, the guardians forfeit that standing from their scores. The farmer's shells have no past to recover and no guardians to burn, so they climb the slow ridge while copper rewards go only to those who worked.
